cases.description: Oversized-single-file review (Checklist item 4): `engine/giant.py` alone (500 lines) exceeds the 100-line budget, but the fail-OPEN rule keeps it in the recommendation set rather than silently dropping it — it is flagged oversized_alone with a note recommending an excerpt or split before loading, the direct callback to this project's own <300-line-per-file modularity rule the user restated this session.
